notes.title: Saving System Update
notes.notes: Hello everyone! I’ve revamped the saving system to improve stability and prevent data loss. Unfortunately, some players may have experienced corrupted save files during the update. I’m truly sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Bug Fixes 18.04.2024 Part 2
notes.notes:
Fixed bug: Ore farm copper and iron models were inverted.
Fixed bug: Metalworking factory stats were not updating after leveling up.

notes.title: Bug Fixes 18.04.2024
notes.notes:
Fixed Achievements: Railroad Expert, Real Estate Pioneer
Fixed bug: Level locks not resetting after deleting a save file and starting a new one.

notes.title: Bug Fixes 15.04.2024
notes.notes:
Fixed Saving Current Level for: Stone Farm, Ore Farm, Stone Factory, Pipes Factory, Metalworking Factory.
Fixed Chinese Characters Missing.
Added Resolution Setting.
Added Run In Background.
Added Save On Quit.

notes.title: Bug Fixes 04.03.2024
notes.notes:
Fixed saving on MacOS.
Fixed bug: player cannot pause the game after returning from the city.
